news.title: New arrests of 17-year-old and 16-year-old for murder in shooting of Powder Springs 18-year-old
news.summary: The victim in the October 30 shooting has been identified as 18-year-old British Hart. A 15-year-old was previously arrested, bringing the arrests to 3 in the case.

news.title: Deadly crash between car, tractor-trailer under investigation in Union City
news.summary: Union City police and Georgia State Patrol investigate a serious car and tractor-trailer crash near South Fulton Parkway.

news.title: 2 officers taken to hospital after responding to domestic disturbance near metro shopping center
news.summary: Two metro Atlanta officers were hospitalized after responding to a domestic disturbance near a shopping center Thursday.

news.title: Police investigating homicide after man found buried under garbage behind house in Atlanta
news.summary: Crime Stoppers tips led Atlanta Police to Rayschon Tooley, 57, buried behind a vacant home. Detectives hope more tips will help them find his killer.

news.title: Tip leads police to shallow grave behind abandoned Atlanta home
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking the public for tips after a homeless man was found shot to death in a shallow grave behind an abandoned home in the Campbellton-Cascade area.
